label: Realm (Capella SSO)
type: the SSO configuration boundary an identity provider is registered under
note: Consolidates two independent mints of the same real concept: 'sso:realm' (most files) and 'auth:realm' (one batch) - kept under sso: since that's the higher-recurrence, more specific namespace, with auth: reserved for the higher-level authentication-vs-authorization axis concepts (auth:sso, auth:mfa).
